name: Ko Hung
source:
Wing Chun master.
A single father with a son awaiting a heart transplant.
He was a member of the Raksasa party because of his skills, but while pursuing the fugitive Xiao Yu, Master Ma blocked his way and they had a fight.
He is later involved in the abduction of Wei, but when Yvet offers to donate a transplant donor, he ends up helping in the rescue operation.
He then leaves the Raksasa party and moves to Hong Kong for his son's transplant surgery, where he meets Zhang Lei.
